text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute seems to be stuck in a
rut, so we
decide to visit a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I quite like shrines. They're so grand, yet
so quiet.
I get why pigeons come here to
relax in the
sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is what people mean when
they talk
about cleansing their spirit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm just here for a little peace of
mind
today.
choice_data_list: Looks like this'll blow any slump right away.
Looks like this'll blow any slump right away, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to assure the gods that I've got
every
intention of working hard.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm responsible for taking care of my
own
problems.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I just keep my head down and do what I
can. And
that means enduring the times
when things aren't
great.
choice_data_list: You've really got your act together.
You've really got your act together, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have the will to keep
working hard,
that's enough, and I'm
grateful for it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: All right, let's head up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I promise to work hard to get out of this
rut I'm
in, so please watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hi there! Are you here to pray too?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you a breath of fresh air?
And such a
responsible young lady,
coming out here to pray.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...?
Are you someone's granny?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, I'm not much older than you.

Anyway, be careful not to hurt yourself
when you
play, you hear?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Okay, I will! Good luck with your races!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know, my spirits have really lifted. I
think I
got a second wind.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, it's certainly possible.
choice_data_list: Feels like the gods are cheering us on.
Feels like the gods are cheering us on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Wonder Acute's spirits up, she
manages to
shake off her slump.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well then, until next time, gods.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my. It looks like rain.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah! I left my dorm room window open!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rain getting into Wonder Acute's room
certainly
doesn't help her recover from
her slump.
